hypotheses.justification: Split on the sign of `buCutScalar κ z`. If it is nonnegative, the proof's square-root scaling step applies as written. If it is negative, the left side is nonpositive because `Real.sqrt` is nonnegative, while the right side is nonnegative from `hM`, `vec3EuclideanNorm_nonneg`, and `Real.sqrt_nonneg`. Thus the inequality holds without this hypothesis.

This follows from `hderiv`: evaluate it at any `j : Fin 3` (for example `0`), and combine `abs_nonneg` with `|spatialPartial (buCutScalar κ) j z| ≤ M`. The rest of the proof can use this derived nonnegativity in place of `hM`.
